title: Queso Chicken Spaghetti
description: Traditional Italian Queso Chicken Spaghetti Just Like Your Midwestern Grandma Used To Make It
steps: Add Velveeta, Monterey Jack cheese, Rotel, green chilies, cream of chicken soup, and whole milk to a pot.
Stir over medium heat until all ingredients are melted and well combined.
Add shredded cooked chicken to the mixture and stir.
Add cooked spaghetti and stir to coat evenly.
Serve with sliced black olives on top if desired.
